messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning v2.16.0 release next week. Need to lock down multi-region rollout windows and the branch cutoff.

Proposed windows (local times):
- US (prod-us): Tue Mar 23, 2026 — 10:00 PT (10:00-10:15 canary), 10:30 PT full
- EU (prod-eu): Tue Mar 23, 2026 — 18:00 CET (18:00-18:30 warmup/canary), 18:45 CET full
- APAC (prod-apac): Wed Mar 24, 2026 — 02:00 JST (02:00-02:15 canary), 02:30 JST full

Branch & cutoff: Mon Mar 22, 2026 23:00 PT freeze. Please have version-bump PRs open by Mon 17:00 PT so QA can run regression checks.

If you're touching infra/config or DB schemas, call it out here — we need to avoid overlapping migrations with region canaries. CC @eng-oncall

Quick commands you can use to prep:
```
git checkout -b release/v2.16.0
./scripts/bump-version.sh 2.16.0
```

I'll create the release branch and schedule canaries in CI. Trying to avoid high-traffic overlap between US and EU windows.

anya: Noted. There's a config + DB migration queued in #eng-platform that will take ~4h. We should not run EU canary until after the migration completes. :eyes:

sam: Good catch. If migration finishes before EU window we can keep the times; otherwise shift EU canary 30m later and delay full by 30m — still OK for downstream teams?

miguel: I can own the US canary. I'll monitor latency/error-rate dashboards and abort if error rate > 1.5% or latency p95 jumps > 200ms.

rachael: I'll take APAC. One question: what's the rollback playbook? last time we had to revert routing rules and it was messy.

sam: Rollback plan: immediate traffic switch to fallback model variant + flip per-region router circuit breaker. Ops runbook at /docs/runbooks/release-rollback.md — please review and suggest additions. We'll keep a 30-min rollback window after full deploy per region.

miguel: Request: can we add a 2-hour warmup low-traffic window before EU full? It helps stabilize caches and KV layers.

anya: +1 to warmup. Also I'll push DB migration notes to the release PR so QA knows which tests to run.

deploy-bot: scheduled release 'v2.16.0' (branch release/v2.16.0) — canaries set for prod-us 2026-03-23T17:00:00Z, prod-eu 2026-03-23T17:30:00Z, prod-apac 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z. CI build: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4532

sam: Final checklist before freeze:
- Open version bump PRs by Mon 17:00 PT
- Add one-line changelog entry in each PR
- QA signoff on canary dashboards (latency/errs/throughput)
- Platform + oncall confirm DB migration slot
- Owners assigned for canary + rollback for each region

rachael: I'll add a changelog reminder to the PR template and ping authors before cutoff.

miguel: Ping me on release morning, I'll be on call and watching dashboards. I'll post a short status update in this thread during canaries.

sam: Thanks all — if no objections by EOD I'll post calendar invites, label the release branch, and lock the cutoff. :thumbsup!
